name: What is a garage-to-home-office conversion?

acceptedAnswer.text: A garage-to-home-office conversion transforms your existing garage space into a functional workspace. This process typically involves insulating walls and ceilings, installing new flooring, adding electrical outlets, ensuring proper lighting, and often integrating heating and cooling systems. It's a popular solution for homeowners seeking dedicated office space without the expense or time commitment of a traditional home addition, utilizing existing structures for a new purpose.
acceptedAnswer.description: A garage-to-home-office conversion transforms an existing garage into a functional workspace, typically involving insulation, flooring, electrical, lighting, and HVAC.
